title: Estrogen Receptor-Low Positive (ER-Low) Breast Cancer: A Unique Clinical and Pathological Entity.
authors: Faa, Gavino; Lai, Eleonora; Ziranu, Pina; Pretta, Andrea; Tiwari, Ekta; Dessi, Mariele; Solinas, Cinzia; Saba, Giorgio; Loi, Francesco; Codipietro, Claudia; Graziano, Simona; Ottelio, Laura; Dessena, Massimo; Coghe, Ferdinando; Suri, Jasjit S; Saba, Luca; Scartozzi, Mario
one_liner_zh: 该文综述ER低表达乳腺癌的临床病理特征，仅提及AI用于ER定量评估，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ER-low breast cancer (1-9% ER expression) represents a biologically and clinically distinct entity at the interface between ER-positive and ER-negative disease. Although traditionally managed as hormone receptor-positive, mounting evidence indicates that ER-low tumors share molecular signatures, aggressive behavior, and chemotherapeutic responsiveness with triple-negative breast cancer. Accurate ER assessment is hindered by methodological variability and interpretative challenges, leading to potential misclassification and suboptimal treatment choices. While the benefit of endocrine therapy remains uncertain, ER-low tumors consistently show sensitivity to chemotherapy and promising responses to neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy, paralleling outcomes observed in triple-negative breast cancer cohorts. Emerging artificial intelligence tools, including digital pathology and multimodal deep learning, may enhance ER quantification, reduce observer variability, and enable more precise patient stratification. This review synthesizes current pathological and clinical insights into ER-low breast cancer and highlights evolving therapeutic strategies, with a forward-looking perspective on AI-driven approaches to optimize personalized treatment for this challenging subtype.
abstract_zh: ER低表达乳腺癌（ER表达1-9%）在生物学和临床上代表了一种介于ER阳性和ER阴性疾病之间的独特实体。尽管传统上按激素受体阳性进行管理，但越来越多的证据表明，ER低表达肿瘤与三阴性乳腺癌共享分子特征、侵袭性行为及化疗敏感性。准确的ER评估受到方法学变异性和判读挑战的阻碍，可能导致错误分类和次优治疗选择。虽然内分泌治疗的获益仍不确定，但ER低表达肿瘤持续表现出对化疗的敏感性，并对新辅助化疗-免疫治疗有良好反应，与三阴性乳腺癌队列中观察到的结果相平行。新兴的人工智能工具，包括数字病理学和多模态深度学习，可能增强ER定量分析、减少观察者间变异，并实现更精确的患者分层。本综述综合了ER低表达乳腺癌的当前病理学和临床见解，并强调了不断演变的治疗策略，以面向未来的视角探讨人工智能驱动的方法，以优化这一具有挑战性亚型的个性化治疗。
